title: Spec Master metrics round
description: One delivery-round row as produced by metrics.record_round() or telemetry.to_round(). The ROOT of this schema describes ONE row; the file .spec-master/metrics/rounds.json is a JSON array of rows and is described by '#/$defs/rounds'. Validated in-repo by spec-master/lib/metrics_export.py (stdlib subset validator: $ref (local), type, required, properties, additionalProperties, enum, minimum, minLength, pattern, format=date-time, items).
$comment: v1.1.0 (metrics v2) adds OPTIONAL provenance and host-usage fields (source, cache_read_input_tokens, cache_creation_input_tokens, turns, cost_usd, cost_basis, human_wait_seconds, lane, session_id); every v1.0.0 row is still valid. Rates (tokens_per_minute, packages_per_hour, features_per_hour) and total_tokens are derived by metrics.record_round(); total_tokens stays input_tokens + output_tokens (cache tokens are separate fields). metrics_export.validate_rounds() additionally enforces what JSON Schema cannot express: consistency warnings (total_tokens != input_tokens + output_tokens, ended_at before started_at), provenance (no source -> warning; manual-unverified -> warning; host source with total_tokens == 0 -> error) and chronology (started_at earlier than the previous row's -> warning, error for host rows; ended_at after now -> warning, error for host rows).

round_id.description: Unique id of the round (e.g. r3-plan-parallel-worktree-execution).

phase.description: Workflow phase the round covered (specify, clarify, plan, tasks, analyze, implement, validate, ...). Free string: record_round does not restrict it.

started_at.description: ISO 8601 start time; 'Z' or an explicit offset (a naive value is read as UTC, like metrics._parse_iso).

duration_seconds.description: ended_at - started_at in seconds (clamped at 0, rounded to 3 decimals).

input_tokens.description: Prompt/input tokens consumed in the round.

output_tokens.description: Completion/output tokens produced in the round.

work_packages_completed.description: Team Mode work packages completed in the round.

notes.description: Optional free-text note (never exported as a metric attribute).

feature_id.description: Optional id of the feature the round worked on (state.json features[].id).

tier.description: Optional sizing/complexity tier label attached to the round.

source.description: Optional provenance of the numbers. host-transcript: aggregated from the Claude Code session transcript (JSONL); host-headless: parsed from `claude -p --output-format json`; manual: typed in with non-zero tokens; manual-unverified: typed in with no measured usage. A row without source is a v1 row and is reported as unverified.

cache_read_input_tokens.description: Optional input tokens served from the prompt cache (not included in input_tokens).

cache_creation_input_tokens.description: Optional input tokens written to the prompt cache (not included in input_tokens).

turns.description: Optional number of model API responses (host-transcript: unique assistant message ids; host-headless: num_turns).

cost_usd.description: Optional cost of the round in US dollars. Only written with cost_basis; never computed from a price table inside Spec Master.

cost_basis.description: Optional origin of cost_usd: measured = reported by the host (e.g. total_cost_usd of claude -p); estimated = anything else.

human_wait_seconds.description: Optional seconds the agent spent waiting for a genuine human prompt (from the last assistant/tool activity to the next human prompt).

lane.description: Optional lane of the work (e.g. patch, standard, critical).

session_id.description: Optional host session id the usage was measured in.

rounds.description: Top-level form of .spec-master/metrics/rounds.json: an array of round rows.

rate.description: Derived throughput rate; 0.0 when the round has zero duration.
